# `make_valid_utf8`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the original string if `str` is a valid UTF-8 string, otherwise returns a new string whose invalid UTF8 byte sequences are replaced using the UNICODE replacement character U+FFFD.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
make_valid_utf8(str)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- make_valid_utf8, example 1
> SELECT make_valid_utf8('Spark');
Spark
```

```sql
-- make_valid_utf8, example 2
> SELECT make_valid_utf8(x'61');
a
```

```sql
-- make_valid_utf8, example 3
> SELECT make_valid_utf8(x'80');
�
```

```sql
-- make_valid_utf8, example 4
> SELECT make_valid_utf8(x'61C262');
a�b
```
